description: The deploy ENTRY GATE — run this first when a user wants to deploy. Verifies the account is ready and AUTO-SELECTS the network_id + keypair_name to pass to deploy_app (so you never hunt for them): (1) account reachable + quota, (2) a private network (picks your default — every account has one), (3) an SSH keypair (if you have none, returns ssh_key_recipe: the exact local ssh-keygen → import_keypair → write SSH_KEY_LOCATION-to-.env steps — run them, in yolo mode without asking). Returns { ready, network_id, keypair_name, missing, ssh_key_recipe }.

mode.description: OMIT by default: the session deploys end to end with no questions (yolo: the default network, a keypair created if missing). Pass 'guided' ONLY when the user explicitly said they want to approve or to be specific about something; it is STICKY for the session once set, so omit it on later re-checks. Defaults to the session's sticky mode, or the no-questions default if never set.

name: check_deploy_prerequisites
title: Check deploy prerequisites (run before plan_deploy)
